name: postern
description: Postern: a private gate from your phone to your browser. End-to-end encrypted transfer via a QR code.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && cd relay && wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 --var RATE_LIMIT:off
scripts.deploy: npm run build:release && cd relay && wrangler deploy
